names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's life for 28 octombrie, «şi au avut şapte fii: Sarvil, Fota, Teodul, Vila, Ierax, Nitul şi Eunichie»; the day's own line for him reads «Sfântul Mucenic Vilie».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη», with the rank words left off. The page's own heading for this child is «Αγια Βηλη», in the feminine.

Read out of the title on this one's name link behind the household's line for 28 октября ст. ст., «Вил Сирийский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The line itself gives the name in the genitive and without the province.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Терентия и Неониллы и чад их: Сарвила , Фота , Феодула , Иеракса , Нита , Вила , Евникии (ок. 249-250).»
source.note: The icon the page sets before this line is «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service with no typikon mark — so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian calendar keeps the whole household on this day in one line and gives each of the nine a name link of its own; this is the sixth of the seven children the line enumerates. The link's title is «Вил Сирийский, мч.», and the stored form is that title with the rank word left off — it adds the province the Romanian and Greek pages do not name. The line itself declines the name, so the nominative is the link's. The year «(ок. 249-250)» is the line's and is new to this folder, which had no date at all.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 28 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Vilie», and on the same day «Sfântul Mucenic Terentie cu cei 7 fii ai săi»

attestations.note: doxologia.ro's line for the day names the seven sons as a company; the life the same page prints enumerates them all by name — «şi au avut şapte fii: Sarvil, Fota, Teodul, Vila, Ierax, Nitul şi Eunichie» — which is why each has his own folder. This son doxologia also gives a line of his own on the day, «Sfântul Mucenic Vilie», whose Viață tab serves the same life of Terence and his seven sons.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the entry enumerates the same household the corpus already keeps as nine folders; «Αγια Βηλη» has her own heading on the page, and is one of the two daughters — the folder's slug and English form, taken from the Romanian «Vila», read the name as a son's, which this reader has not changed. No year is given, so no `dates` object. The apolytikion names the seven children as a company and is taken into all nine folders; the Κάθισμα is neither a troparion nor a kontakion and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Terentie, al Sfintei Neonila și al celor împreună cu dânșii, Glasul 4

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received from you, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for possessing your strength they overthrew their torturers and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Νόμω φύσεως, συνδεδεμένοι, κράτος πίστεως, ἐνδεδυμένοι, μαρτυρίου τὴν ὁδὸν διηνύσατε, σὺν Νεονίλλη θεόφρον Τερέντιε, καὶ ἡ τῶν Παίδων ὑμῶν ἑπτὰς ἔνθεος. Καὶ νῦν ἄφεσιν, αἰτήσασθε παμμακάριστοι, τοὶς μέλπουσιν ὑμῶν τὴν θείαν ἄθλησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη». It names Terence and Neonilla and their godly seven children, and no other saint.

english.text: Bound together by the law of nature, and clothed with the strength of faith, you finished the road of martyrdom, Terence of godly mind, with Neonilla and the godly seven of your children. And now, all-blessed ones, ask forgiveness for those who sing of your divine contest.

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего:/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости,/ тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников Терентия и Неонилы и чад их»
source.note: The common of martyrs, printed under the household's name, which makes it theirs (BRIEF.md §4); it names none of them.

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from you, our God; for having your strength they cast down the tormentors and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Мученическая честная память прииде днесь,/ веселящи всяческая,/ Терентия премудраго и подружии его,/ тепле убо стецемся,/ да приимем исцеление,/ сии бо благодать приемше от Духа Святаго// исцеляти недуги и болезни душ наших.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников Терентия и Неонилы и чад их»
source.note: The household's own kontakion, and the only hymn on the day that names any of them: «Терентия премудраго и подружии его».

english.text: The honoured memory of the martyrs has come today, gladdening all things — of Terence the most wise and of his consort. Let us run to them with warmth, that we may receive healing; for they have received grace from the Holy Spirit to heal the infirmities and the sicknesses of our souls.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 28 октября ст. ст. closes the household with «(ок. 249-250)» — about 249 to 250. The Romanian and Greek pages this folder was written from give no year at all, so the interval is the Russian calendar's alone and is the household's and not this one person's.
